layout: Left page of opening: rows = mother tongue (Local/Non-Local) within area blocks; columns 3-5 number speaking the mother tongue, 6-17 subsidiary Local languages Balochi, Dehwari (Local Persian), Pashto, Lahnda (or Western Punjabi), each P/M/F.
notes: Areas: Loralai District (total) with Duki Tahsil, Bori Tahsil, Sanjawi Sub-Tahsil, Barkhan Tahsil, Musakhel Tahsil; Zhob District (total; its tahsils - Fort Sandeman, Hindubagh, ... - are printed on leaf 393, so Zhob nesting not checkable here). All P=M+F, block TOTAL-row checks and Loralai = sum of its five tahsils/sub-tahsil pass for every column.
